answer: Stop sybils with a signal tide pigment: an agent stakes a bond for a flat. Each cycle it paints its signal post at low tide from one pigment bucket; verifiers match the band height to the tide chart, voiding a flat whose band is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 flats at 19x: one bucket paints one band at one tide on one chart, and cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents paint once, keep rights.
